steps.narrate: We begin on the contact form page where users can send messages to the support team.
The form includes fields for name, email, subject, and message.
First, the user enters their full name.
Next, the email address is provided so the team can respond.
The user selects the subject category from the dropdown menu.

fill.value: Hello, I have a question about your product features and pricing plans. Could you provide more details about the enterprise tier?

steps.narrate: The user composes their message in the text area. The form supports multi-line input.
With the form completed, the user reviews the entries before submitting.
At the bottom of the form, there is a submit button and a privacy policy link.
The user clicks Submit to send the message.
A success message confirms the submission was received.
The user can send another message or navigate to a different section.
